mitigationObjective: Activate alternate logistics corridors and standby shift rosters to minimize factory-floor downtime.

steps: Isolate compromised network switches to quarantine ransomware vectors.
Deploy backup offline telemetry capture setups on primary manufacturing lines.
Activate pre-audited disaster recovery servers and initialize database restoration.
mitigationPlan.timeline: 24 to 72 hours for server recovery and network quarantine

steps: Execute complete antivirus and vulnerability scans across all reconnected hosts.
Verify data logs are back to operational synchronization standards.
validationPlan.timeline: 12 hours of network safety logging before production restart
